stem: A recipe uses 3 cups of flour to make 24 cookies. At this rate, how many cups of flour are needed to make 40 cookies?
explanation: 3 cups per 24 cookies is 1/8 cup per cookie. 40 × 1/8 = 5 cups.
source: Emir original item, written to the College Board Digital SAT content specifications
steps: Write the proportion: 3 cups / 24 cookies = x cups / 40 cookies.
key: Set up a proportion with matching units.
